what: Retiring lib-execution-issues.sh leaves a live finalize dependency unresolved
scenario_or_breakage: Step 16/18 loads scripts/implement-finalize.sh; after the lib is deleted, source fails before cleanup and the safety-net call to write_execution_issues_records is gone
suggested_fix: Add scripts/implement-finalize.sh and scripts/test-implement-finalize.sh to the plan; replace the sourced helper with the Python execution-issues flush/record API before deleting the lib

what: Step 0 direct cutover omits wrapper-owned resume rehydration
scenario_or_breakage: The plan deletes step-0-bootstrap.sh and repoints Step 0 to bootstrap invoke, but bootstrap invoke currently does not restore preflight-tmpdir.env, run-flags, parent-issue/run id, fork metadata, or LARCH_CLAUDE_PID that the wrapper supplies; dirty-tree or degraded resume can lose issue/run/fork flags and route incorrectly
suggested_fix: Add python/bootstrap.py to the plan or add an in-process implement step0 verb that absorbs the wrapper rehydration before deleting it; cover resume/fork/emergency/self-review rehydration

what: Surviving lint harnesses still assert retired wrapper paths
scenario_or_breakage: The plan updates some harnesses but omits existing make lint targets that require step-0-bootstrap.sh, step-5-review.sh, step-8-ship.sh, and other deleted wrappers; after SKILL.md is repointed, these targets fail before the PR can be verified
suggested_fix: Add these harnesses to Files to modify/create and update assertions to the new cli.py verbs, or delete/retarget harnesses that only protect deleted wrappers
